ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of Doha's location. It can be seen that Doha is located in the coastal area of the eastern Arabian Peninsula, near the Persian Gulf area; its latitude is north of 20°N, belonging to a low-latitude region. Then reason: The region where Doha is located originally has a hot and arid climate. Global warming will further raise the temperature and make evaporation stronger. After a large amount of soil water evaporates, salts easily remain and accumulate toward the soil surface, so it may lead to soil secondary salinization.
